newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 1.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Oct. 1:

WASHINGTON - After brushing aside last minute Arab appeals for a delay, President Clinton convenes an emergency summit meeting of Arab and Israeli leaders designed to break a new cycle of violence that threatens the Middle East peace process.
WASHINGTON - The Clinton Administration plans to ease restrictions on the export of information scrambling technology.

BALTIMORE - Major League Baseball's umpires threatened to boycott playoff games unless the Baltimore Orioles' second baseman is ordered to begin immediately a five-game suspension for spitting on an umpire.

WASHINGTON - Congress approves major packages, including the 1997 budget bill and immigration legislation that attempts to clamp off the influx of illegal aliens, but stops short of changing legal immigrants' access to federal benefits.
WASHINGTON - Elizabeth Dole and Hillary Rodham Clinton display their own distinct campaign styles as they stump for their husbands ahead of the November presidential election.
WASHINGTON - A far-reaching welfare law requiring recipients to work took effect Tuesday and already was playing out in diverse and unforseen ways in states across the country.
